purpose: external confirmation of SAFE-MI findings after AnnoMI development was consumed

source.full_data_access: requires the official author-hosted access request form

access_sequence: download the public sample at the pinned commit
audit exact and fuzzy title overlap before inspecting sample outcomes
audit exact normalized transcript and local-shingle overlap
request the full corpus under its official terms
apply the same audit and deterministic split without changing thresholds

overlap_audit.mi_tags_group: normalized Video Title until full source URLs are supplied
overlap_audit.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, alphanumeric tokens separated by one space
overlap_audit.quarantine_rule: quarantine if any title threshold or transcript threshold is met

locked_split.unit: normalized Video Title source group after overlap quarantine
locked_split.rule: SHA256(group_key) interpreted as an integer modulo 5
locked_split.fallback_if_minimum_not_met: blocked; do not alter the rule after outcome access

task_a.claim_boundary: The AnnoMI uploader quality target is not equated with any MITI global score.

task_c.target: mapped next therapist MITI behaviour after a client turn
task_c.claim_boundary: Forecasting the recorded action does not identify an optimal intervention.

confirmation_rule.comparison: SAFE-MI finalist versus the frozen-GRU matched external baseline
confirmation_rule.task_a_direction: report all four ordinal outcomes; no binary-quality equivalence claim
confirmation_rule.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four Task A targets
